VancouverSun.title: Tours provide a local’s guide to delicious dining in Puerto Vallarta

venues.name: Abulón Antojería del Mar
venues.address: Hamburgo 137, Versalles, 48310 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Open-air seafood restaurant with treed patio seating and creative tuna, shrimp, and octopus dishes.
venues.signatureOrder: Shrimp al pastor tacos with pineapple and avocado cream; alternatively a tuna tostada.
venues.practicalNote: A sit-down seafood meal; shellfish and raw preparations are common. Ask about ingredients.
venues.identityNotes: Vancouver Sun explicitly gives Hamburgo 137; live Places matches. Other articles identify the same Versalles restaurant.
venues.subtitle: A leafy seafood courtyard

venues.name: Tacón de Marlín
venues.subtitle: The coastal burrita
venues.description: Smoky marlin, shrimp and octopus tucked into griddled flour-tortilla burritas. This is coastal comfort food, not a rice-and-bean burrito.
venues.signatureOrder: Start with a smoked-marlin burrita; try mixed seafood if you want variety.
venues.practicalNote: Honduras branch only — not the airport location. Expect fish, shellfish, wheat and often cheese; ask about ingredients.

venues.name: El Puerco de Oro
venues.address: Mérida 128, Versalles, 48310 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Focused neighborhood taquería known for pork belly on heirloom blue-corn tortillas, with pork in salsa verde and a bean-and-cheese option.
venues.signatureOrder: Pork belly tacos on blue-corn tortillas; try the salsa counter.
venues.practicalNote: Breakfast/lunch only on the live listing, 9 am–3 pm daily; use Mérida 128, not the older España address.
venues.identityNotes: Moved: Eater selects 325 D Calle España, but current Places resolves both name-only and old-address searches to Mérida 128. TMVersalles explicitly reports the move to Mérida 128; retain this as a relocated editorial venue, not an exact old-address branch match.
venues.subtitle: Pork belly, blue corn

venues.name: Marisma Fish Taco
venues.address: Naranjo 320, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Daytime taco stand known for fried-to-order fish strips in handmade corn tortillas and seafood guisados.
venues.signatureOrder: Taco de dedo de pescado: battered fish with cabbage, salsa and chipotle crema.
venues.practicalNote: Daytime stop; bring cash per TMSeafood. Use Naranjo 320, not the closed Versalles branch.
venues.identityNotes: Eater explicitly selects Naranjo 320 and Places matches. MND discusses both branches and focuses on Versalles; count is brand-level, not proof all articles reviewed Naranjo. TMVersalles now reports Versalles closed, independently corroborated by live Places at Hamburgo 156B.
venues.subtitle: Fish fried to order

venues.name: Birriería y Taquería Liz
venues.subtitle: A proper birria breakfast
venues.description: Slow-cooked beef and goat birria, served in soft or crisp tacos with rich consommé. A neighborhood morning stop, rather than a late-night taquería.
venues.signatureOrder: Ask for tacos dorados (crisp) or suaves (soft), with consommé on the side. Confirm which meat is available.
venues.practicalNote: Dorados means crisp; suaves means soft. Quesabirria adds cheese. Ask before adding salsa — heat varies.

venues.name: La Tía Ñaña
venues.subtitle: A home-style seafood pause
venues.description: A modest neighborhood seafood spot, also written La Tía Nana in travel guides. Marlin burritos and shrimp broth are highlighted by México Desconocido.
venues.signatureOrder: Try the marlin burrito and ask whether caldo de camarón (shrimp broth) is available.
venues.practicalNote: Look for Ñaña. Google currently names this Honduras 215 branch Mariscos La Tía Ñaña • DESDE 1975; older guide map pins differ slightly. Menu availability may vary; ask what is cooking.

venues.name: Tacos de Cabeza el Chulo
venues.address: Aguacate 263-209, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Street-side specialist in steamed beef-head tacos, with tender meat and steamed tortillas.
venues.signatureOrder: Cachete, lengua or surtido tacos al vapor.
venues.practicalNote: Cachete is cheek, lengua is tongue, surtido is a mix. Closing after midnight belongs to the following calendar day.
venues.identityNotes: Both editorials and live Places say Aguacate 263-209. Preserve the full unusual number; do not truncate it to Aguacate 263.
venues.subtitle: Tender tacos al vapor

venues.name: Lamara
venues.address: Hamburgo 108, Versalles, 48310 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Casual seafood spot offering multiple ceviches and aguachiles, including fruit-and-chile combinations.
venues.signatureOrder: Aguachile or ceviche tostadas; Vancouver Sun also describes tuna, avocado and pineapple tacos.
venues.practicalNote: Ask how spicy the aguachile is before choosing. Raw seafood preparations are common.
venues.identityNotes: Vancouver Sun gives Hamburgo 108; Places matches and TMSeafood map coordinates point to the same location.
venues.subtitle: Ceviche with a creative streak

venues.name: Miscelánea Vallarta
venues.address: C. Milán #255, Versalles, 48310 Mexico, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Breakfast and brunch café using sourdough, with Mexican breakfast sandwiches, oat pancakes and coffee drinks.
venues.signatureOrder: Sourdough molletes or a chilaquiles torta, with coco brew.
venues.practicalNote: A breakfast-and-brunch café rather than a late-night taco stop. Ask about ingredients and availability.
venues.identityNotes: Exact Eater branch at Calle Milán #255 matches Places street, postcode and coordinates. Google unusually labels locality as Mexico rather than Puerto Vallarta; raw formattedAddress is preserved rather than silently corrected.
venues.subtitle: Sourdough and a slow morning

venues.name: Ocho Tostadas
venues.address: Río Guayaquil 413, Lázaro Cárdenas, 48330 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Long-running seafood institution known for ceviche tostadas, fish chicharrón and crab-filled tacos.
venues.signatureOrder: Ceviche molido tostada with shrimp or scallops; add chicharrón de pescado or taquitos de jaiba.
venues.practicalNote: Bring cash per Eater; live Estadio listing is noon–7 pm, closed Wednesday.
venues.identityNotes: Eater explicitly selects Río Guayaquil 413, described as the original; live listing is named Mariscos 8 Tostadas Estadio at that exact address. TMSeafood calls it 5 de Diciembre but its embedded map points to Marina coordinates (20.6660194,-105.2486763), so its branch evidence conflicts. Count remains brand-level; do not replace the Eater branch with the linked Marina branch.
venues.subtitle: The original Estadio seafood stop

venues.name: Tacos La Mucca
venues.address: Camichin 172, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Historical editorial pick: chef-led taquería serving a substantial local-style arriero taco with wood-fired Angus beef.
venues.signatureOrder: Historical signature: taco arriero with carne asada, melted cheese, beans and minced cabbage.
venues.practicalNote: Do not send visitors here as an active recommendation: Google lists this exact branch permanently closed.
venues.identityNotes: Eater selects Camichín 172; Places returns La Mucca Taquería at Camichin 172, CLOSED_PERMANENTLY. Broader name search returns the same closed place only; no replacement location was verified, and no movedPlaceId was returned.
venues.subtitle: Historical arriero specialist

venues.name: Tacos Memo Grill
venues.address: Basilio Badillo Lb, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Historical street-side grill specializing in asada tacos, tortas, burritos and local-style volcanes.
venues.signatureOrder: Historical signature: volcán with grilled meat, cheese, beans and salsa on a tostada.
venues.practicalNote: Do not treat as an operating late-night option: Google lists Taco Memo’s Grill permanently closed.
venues.identityNotes: Both editorials specify Aguacate at Basilio Badillo. Places returns Taco Memo’s Grill near that corner with the malformed number Basilio Badillo Lb, preserved verbatim, CLOSED_PERMANENTLY. Name-only follow-up returns the same closed listing; no movedPlaceId or replacement verified.
venues.subtitle: Historical volcanes from the grill

venues.name: Tacos Sahuayo
venues.address: Paseo Benemérito de las Americas 290, La Vena, 48320 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Neighborhood taco stand known for well-seasoned, flame-charred al pastor with warm spice notes.
venues.signatureOrder: Al pastor tacos from the trompo; tortas or volcanes are alternatives.
venues.practicalNote: An evening taco stop. The listed early-morning closing belongs to the following calendar day.
venues.identityNotes: Eater address and live Places match Paseo Benemérito de las Americas 290, La Vena. MND loosely locates it on the Versalles/Santa Maria border; retain La Vena as the exact listing neighborhood.
venues.subtitle: A late-night al pastor institution

venues.name: Tuna Azul
venues.address: Lisboa 171, Versalles, 48310 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
venues.description: Contemporary casual seafood restaurant emphasizing tuna tostadas and sashimi, with cooked seafood tacos and ceviche.
venues.signatureOrder: Tuna tostada or shrimp ceviche, followed by a fried fish taco.
venues.practicalNote: Select Tuna Azul Versalles at Lisboa 171, not another branch; live hours are 2–9 pm daily.
venues.identityNotes: TMVersalles explicitly names Lisboa 171 and Places matches Tuna Azul Versalles. TMSeafood places its recommendation in Versalles; its menu description is brand-level.
venues.subtitle: A tuna-forward Versalles stop

venues.name: El Carboncito
venues.subtitle: When the pastor spit turns
venues.description: A late-night neighborhood institution for tacos al pastor: marinated pork carved from a rotating spit, with the usual salsa-and-lime ritual.
venues.signatureOrder: Order tacos al pastor and a side of grilled spring onions (cebollitas).
venues.practicalNote: Casual indoor and sidewalk seating. Listed 01:00 closing is after midnight, on the following calendar day.

venues.name: Julio’s Churros
venues.subtitle: The cinnamon-sugar finale
venues.description: A street stand known for churros fried to order, then rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eater profiles Julio and his wife Paty and their long-running neighborhood tradition.
venues.signatureOrder: A fresh batch of plain cinnamon-sugar churros. Ask for the current portion and price.
venues.address: Uruguay 206–248, at Perú · behind Casa Ley
venues.practicalNote: This is a street vendor, not a full-service restaurant. Setup and sell-out times can vary; a published schedule is not a guarantee.
